title: ioctl_key_import: does not validate op.algo is non-empty
description: Same as KEY_GENERATE issue: ioctl_key_import() forces null-termination on op.algo but does not check if op.algo[0]=='\0'. Empty algo string leads to -ENOENT (lookup miss) instead of -EINVAL (bad argument). ioctl_init() correctly returns -EINVAL for empty algo; ioctl_key_import and ioctl_key_generate do not. Trigger: KEY_IMPORT with algo[0]='\0' → -ENOENT instead of -EINVAL.
